学习目标与数据模型
Learning Goals and the Data Model

Page 1

1 Learning Goals

  1. Be able to use the method of least squares to fit a line to bivariate data.
  2. Be able to give a formula for the total squared error when fitting any type of curve to data.
  3. Be able to say the words homoscedasticity and heteroscedasticity.

2 Introduction

Suppose we have collected bivariate data (xi​,yi​), i=1,…,n. The goal of linear regression is to model the relationship between x and y by finding a function y=f(x) that is a close fit to the data. The modeling assumptions we will use are that xi​ is not random and that yi​ is a function of xi​ plus some random noise. With these assumptions x is called the independent or predictor variable and y is called the dependent or response variable.

Here is a series of examples showing the results of linear regression. We will discuss the details of how to do linear regression in the next section.

线性回归 linear regression 用函数 f(x) 近似响应变量. 预测变量 predictor variable x 在这里视为已知且不随机; 响应变量 response variable y 由 f(x) 加随机噪声组成.

拟合和因果不是一回事. 回归先描述 x 与 y 的关系, 是否能作因果解释还取决于数据来源和研究设计.

Slides 4–5

Modeling bivariate data as a function + noise

Ingredients

  • Bivariate data (x1​,y1​),(x2​,y2​),…,(xn​,yn​).
  • Model: y=f(x)+E where f(x) is a function we pick (the model) and E is random error.
    Total squared error: i=1∑n​Ei2​=i=1∑n​(yi​−f(xi​))2.

The model predicts or explains the value of y for any given value of x.

  • x is called the independent or predictor variable.
  • y is the dependent or response variable.
  • Typically: the error is from an imperfect model or imperfect measurement

Examples of f(x)

  • lines: y=ax+b
  • polynomials: y=ax2+bx+c
  • other: y=a/x+b
  • other: y=ceax

第 i 个误差是观测值与函数值之差 Ei​=yi​−f(xi​). 总平方误差把所有误差先平方再求和, 因此正负误差不会互相抵消, 大误差也会受到更重的惩罚.

函数形式可以多样. 「线性回归」中的「线性」不是要求 f(x) 的图像必为直线, 后面会按参数来区分.

邮票、身高与曲线拟合
Stamps, Heights, and Curve Fitting

Pages 1–2

Example 1. The cost of a first class stamp in cents over time is given in the following list.
0.05 (1963) 0.06 (1968) 0.08 (1971) 0.10 (1974) 0.13 (1975) 0.15 (1978) 0.20 (1981)
0.22 (1985) 0.25 (1988) 0.29 (1991) 0.32 (1995) 0.33 (1999) 0.34 (2001) 0.37 (2002)
0.39 (2006) 0.41 (2007) 0.42 (2008) 0.44 (2009) 0.45 (2012) 0.46 (2013) 0.49 (2015)
0.49 (2017) 0.50 (2018) 0.55 (2019)

Using the R function lm we found the ‘least squares fit’ for a line to this data is

y=−0.21390+0.88203x,

where x is the number of years since 1960 and y is in cents.

Using this result we ‘predict’ that in 2021 (x=61) the cost of a stamp will be 53.6 cents (since −0.21390+0.88203⋅61=53.6).

Stamp cost (cents) vs. time (years since 1960). Orange dot is predicted cost in 2021.
Note that none of the data points actually lie on the line. Rather this line has the ‘best fit’ with respect to all the data, with a small error for each data point.
(Note, the actual cost of a stamp dropped in January 2021 was 55 cents. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_United_States_postage_rates)

这里把 1960 年记为 x=0, 所以 2021 年对应 x=61. 直线给出约 53.6 美分, 实际为 55 美分. 预测值不必与任何样本点重合, 也不要求回归线穿过数据点.

读图: 散点显示长期上升趋势, 但并非严格等速增长. 直线是对整段历史的概括, 外推到新年份时仍会有误差.

幻灯片前后不一致: 原文说列表给出的是「in cents」, 但 1963 年写成 0.05, 后面的拟合值和纵轴又都以美分计. 列表数值实际采用美元: 0.05 美元 = 5 美分. 若列表坚持用美分, 应写成 5,6,8,…,55; 两种单位不能混用.

Page 2

Example 2. Suppose we have n pairs of fathers and adult sons. Let xi​ and yi​ be the heights of the ith father and son, respectively. The least squares line for this data could be used to predict the adult height of a young boy from that of his father.

Example 3. We are not limited to best fit lines. For all positive d, the method of least squares may be used to find a polynomial of degree d with the ‘best fit’ to the data. Here’s a figure showing the least squares fit of a parabola (d=2).

Fitting a parabola, ax2+bx+c, to data

Example 4. In fact, we can use linear regression to fit many other types of curves to bivariate data.

父子身高例中, 父亲身高是预测变量, 儿子成年后的身高是响应变量. 拟合线利用成对样本估计平均关系.

抛物线 parabola 是二次多项式. 最小二乘不只拟合直线, 也能在选定曲线族后寻找使平方误差最小的参数.

用最小二乘法拟合直线
Fitting a Line Using Least Squares

Page 3

3 Fitting a line using least squares

Suppose we have data (xi​,yi​) as above. Our first goal is to find the line

y=ax+b

that ‘best fits’ the data. Our model says that each yi​ is predicted by xi​ up to some error ϵi​:

yi​=axi​+b+ϵi​.

So

ϵi​=yi​−axi​−b.

The method of least squares finds the values a^ and b^ of a and b that minimize the sum of the squared errors:

S(a,b)=i∑​ϵi2​=i∑​(yi​−axi​−b)2.

Using calculus or linear algebra (details in the appendix), we find

a^=sxx​sxy​​,b^=yˉ​−a^xˉ(1)

where

xˉ=n1​∑xi​,yˉ​=n1​∑yi​,
sxx​=n−11​∑(xi​−xˉ)2,sxy​=n−11​∑(xi​−xˉ)(yi​−yˉ​).

Here xˉ is the sample mean of x, yˉ​ is the sample mean of y, sxx​ is the sample variance of x, and sxy​ is the sample covariance of x and y.

最小二乘法 method of least squares 把 a,b 当作待选参数, 最小化目标函数 S(a,b). 带帽的 a^,b^ 是由这组样本算出的估计值.

斜率是样本协方差与 x 的样本方差之比. 截距公式等价于 yˉ​=a^xˉ+b^, 所以拟合线必过样本中心 (xˉ,yˉ​). 这些公式只适用于简单线性回归, 不能直接套到抛物线.

易错: 分母 sxx​ 必须大于 0. 若所有 xi​ 都相同, 就无法用这些公式确定一条通常意义下的回归线.

Page 3

Example 5. Use least squares to fit a line to the following data: (0,1),(2,1),(3,4).

Solution: In our case, (x1​,y1​)=(0,1), (x2​,y2​)=(2,1) and (x3​,y3​)=(3,4). So

xˉ=35​,yˉ​=2,sxx​=37​,sxy​=2.

Using the above formulas we get

a^=76​,b^=74​.

So the least squares line has equation y=76​x+74​. This is shown as the orange line in the following figure. We will discuss the blue parabola soon.

Least squares fit of a line (orange) and a parabola (blue)

三个点并不共线, 所以直线会有非零残差. 蓝色抛物线则有三个参数, 在这个例子中恰好能穿过三个点.

穿过更多点不等于模型更好: 直线和抛物线是在不同函数族中分别最小化平方误差, 还应考虑复杂度和对新数据的预测表现.

残差、同方差与异方差
Residuals, Homoscedasticity, and Heteroscedasticity

Page 4

Simple linear regression: It’s a little confusing, but the word linear in ‘linear regression’ does not refer to fitting a line. We will explain its meaning below. However, the most common curve to fit is a line. When we fit a line to bivariate data it is called simple linear regression.

3.1 Residuals

For a line the model is

yi​=a^xi​+b^+ϵi​.

We think of a^xi​+b^ as predicting or explaining yi​. The left-over term ϵi​ is called the residual, which we think of as random noise or measurement error. A useful visual check of the linear regression model is to plot the residuals. The data points should hover near the regression line. The residuals should look about the same across the range of x.

Data with regression line (left) and residuals (right). Note the homoscedasticity.

简单线性回归 simple linear regression 指用一个预测变量拟合直线. 残差 residual 是观测值减去拟合值: ei​=yi​−y^​i​. 它落在回归线的上方时为正, 下方时为负.

残差图把拟合值部分移除, 更便于检查是否还有曲线趋势、异常点或随 x 改变的散布.

Pages 4–5

3.2 Homoscedasticity

An important assumption of the linear regression model is that the residuals ϵi​ have the same variance for all i. This is called homoscedasticity. You can see this is the case for both figures above. The data hovers in the band of fixed width around the regression line and at every x the residuals have about the same vertical spread.

Below is a figure showing heteroscedastic data. The vertical spread of the data increases as x increases. Before using least squares on this data we would need to transform the data to be homoscedastic.

Heteroscedastic Data

同方差性 homoscedasticity 指误差方差不随 i 或 x 改变; 异方差性 heteroscedasticity 指误差方差不恒定. 本图表现为扇形展开, 而不是整条趋势消失.

普通最小二乘仍可能给出一条拟合线, 但恒定方差假设被破坏后, 常用的标准误、置信区间和检验可能失真. 数据变换是一种处理办法, 加权最小二乘也是常见方向.

用线性回归拟合多项式
Linear Regression for Fitting Polynomials

Page 5

4 Linear regression for fitting polynomials

When we fit a line to data it is called simple linear regression. We can also use linear regression to fit polynomials to data. The use of the word linear in both cases may seem confusing. This is because the word ‘linear’ in linear regression does not refer to fitting a line. Rather it refers to the linear algebraic equations for the unknown parameters.

Example 6. Take the same data as in Example 5 and use least squares to find the best fitting parabola to the data.

Solution: A parabola has the formula y=ax2+bx+c. The squared error is

S(a,b,c)=i∑​(yi​−(axi2​+bxi​+c))2.

After substituting the given values for each xi​ and yi​, we can use calculus to find the triple (a,b,c) that minimizes S. With this data, we find that the least squares parabola has equation

y=x2−2x+1.

Note that for 3 points the quadratic fit is perfect.

Least squares fit of a line (orange) and a parabola (blue)

Example 7. The pairs (xi​,yi​) may give the age and vocabulary size of a n children. Since we expect that young children acquire new words at an accelerating pace, we might guess that a higher order polynomial would best fit the data.

把 1,x,x2 看成三个已知特征, y=ax2+bx+c 对参数 a,b,c 仍是线性的. 对参数求偏导并令其为 0, 得到的也是线性方程组.

例 6 中 x2−2x+1=(x−1)2, 在 x=0,2,3 处分别给出 1,1,4, 因而总平方误差为 0. 这里只是三个点恰好唯一确定一条抛物线, 不代表二次模型普遍优于直线.

原文笔误: Example 7 写的是「of a n children」, 不定冠词与复数冲突. 应为「of n children」.

数据变换、过拟合与 R 的 lm
Transformations, Overfitting, and R’s lm

Page 6

Example 8. (Transforming the data) Sometimes it is necessary to transform the data before using linear regression. For example, let’s suppose the relationship is exponential, i.e. y=ceax. Then

ln(y)=ax+ln(c).

So we can use simple linear regression on the data (xi​,ln(yi​)) to obtain a model

ln(y)=a^x+b^

and then exponentiate to obtain the exponential model

y=eb^ea^x.

取对数把指数关系变成直线, 其中斜率是 a, 截距是 b=lnc, 所以还原时 c=eb^. 这一变换要求 yi​>0, 且指数模型中的 c>0.

误差尺度会改变: 对 (xi​,lnyi​) 做最小二乘, 最小化的是对数尺度上的平方误差, 通常不等同于直接最小化 ∑i​(yi​−ceaxi​)2.

Pages 6–7

4.1 Overfitting

You can always achieve a better fit by using a higher order polynomial. For instance, given 6 data points (with distinct xi​) one can always find a fifth order polynomial that goes through all of them. This can result in what’s called overfitting. That is, fitting the noise as well as the true relationship between x and y. An overfit model will fit the original data better but perform less well on predicting y for new values of x. Indeed, a primary challenge of statistical modeling is balancing model fit against model complexity.

Example 9. In the plot below, we fit polynomials of degree 1, 2, and 9 to bivariate data consisting of 10 data points. The degree 2 model (maroon) gives a significantly better fit than the degree 1 model (blue). The degree 10 model (orange) gives fits the data exactly, but at a glance we would guess it is overfit. That is, we don’t expect it to do a good job fitting the next data point we see.

In fact, we generated this data using a quadratic model, so the degree 2 model will tend to perform best fitting new data points.

4.2 R function lm

As you would expect we don’t actually do linear regression by hand. Computationally, linear regression reduces to solving simultaneous equations, i.e. to matrix calculations. The R function lm can be used to fit any order polynomial to data. (lm stands for linear model). We will explore this in the next studio class. In fact lm can fit many types of functions besides polynomials, as you can explore using R help or google.

过拟合 overfitting 是模型连噪声也一起记住. 十个横坐标不同的点可由九次多项式精确穿过, 但点间和点外的剧烈摆动往往不利于预测新数据.

模型选择要同时看拟合优度与复杂度. 训练数据上的误差继续下降, 并不能保证新数据上的误差也下降. 本讲没有实际划分训练集和测试集, 二次模型更适合新数据是因为已知数据由二次机制生成.

R 的 lm 表示 线性模型 linear model. 它承担方程求解和矩阵计算, 但「线性」仍指参数结构, 不是只能拟合直线.

幻灯片前后不一致: Example 9 前一句和图都拟合 1、2、9 次多项式, 后一句却写「The degree 10 model (orange)」. 橙色曲线应为 degree 9; 十个横坐标不同的点由九次多项式精确插值.

原文笔误: 同一句中的「gives fits the data exactly」多了一个动词. 应为「fits the data exactly」或「gives an exact fit to the data」.

Slide 18

Outliers and other troubles

Question: Can one point change the regression line significantly?

Use mathlet
https://mathlets.org/mathlets/linear-regression/

可以. 平方损失会放大残差较大的点, 而远离样本中心 (xˉ,yˉ​) 的点还可能明显改变斜率. 课堂 applet 的设想是: 先放入一批斜率约为 −1 的点, 再加一个远处的点, 观察拟合线跳动.

离群点 outlier 是相对于模型或数据模式异常的点. 不应只因它影响结果就自动删除; 先核对测量、录入和数据生成过程, 再报告它是否改变结论.

离群与高杠杆不同: 响应值 y 异常但 x 普通的点未必大幅改变斜率; x 远离其他观测的点具有较高 杠杆率 leverage, 若它又不符合其余点的趋势, 往往更有影响力.

课堂题: 建立各种拟合
Board Question: Make It Fit

Slide 10

Board question: make it fit

We are given bivariate data: (1,3),(2,1),(4,4).

  1. Do (simple) linear regression to find the best fitting line.
    1. Give the model for simple linear regression.
    2. Write down the formula for the total squared error.
    3. Use calculus to find the parameters that minimize the total squared error.
  2. Do linear regression to find the best fitting parabola. (Really just set this up and get as far as needing to solve equations to find the coefficients.)
  3. Find the best fitting exponential y=eax+b. (As before, set up the equations but don’t solve them.)
    Hint: take ln(y) and do simple linear regression.
  4. For data (x1​,y1​),…,(xn​,yn​). Set up the linear regression to find the best fitting cubic. Don’t try to take derivatives or actually find the formulas for the coefficients.

(a) 直线: 模型为 yi​=axi​+b+Ei​, 目标函数为 S(a,b)=∑i=13​(yi​−axi​−b)2. 分别对 b,a 求偏导并令其为 0:

i=1∑3​−2(yi​−axi​−b)=0,i=1∑3​−2xi​(yi​−axi​−b)=0.

本题的 xˉ=7/3,yˉ​=8/3,sxx​=7/3,sxy​=7/6, 所以

a^=sxx​sxy​​=21​,b^=yˉ​−a^xˉ=23​.

最佳拟合直线是 y^​=x/2+3/2​. 三个拟合值依次为 2,5/2,7/2.

(b) 抛物线: 最小化 S(a,b,c)=∑i​(yi​−axi2​−bxi​−c)2. 三个点给出方程

a+b+c=3,4a+2b+c=1,16a+4b+c=4.

解得 a=7/6,b=−11/2,c=22/3, 因而 y^​=7x2/6−11x/2+22/3​. 它精确穿过三点.

(c) 指数曲线: 令 zi​=lnyi​, 对 (xi​,zi​) 拟合 z=ax+b. 这里 z1​=ln3,z2​=0,z3​=ln4, 求得

a^=145ln4−4ln3​,b^=ln23​.

因此 y^​=23​exp(145ln4−4ln3​x)​. 这是按题目提示得到的对数尺度最小二乘解.

(d) 三次多项式: 模型写成 yi​=axi3​+bxi2​+cxi​+d+Ei​, 只需最小化

S(a,b,c,d)=i=1∑n​(yi​−axi3​−bxi2​−cxi​−d)2.

四个目标函数仍分别对未知参数是二次的, 求导后都得到线性方程.

多元线性回归
Multiple Linear Regression

Page 7

5 Multiple linear regression

Data is not always bivariate. It can be trivariate or even of some higher dimension. Suppose we have data in the form of tuples

(yi​,x1,i​,x2,i​,…,xm,i​)

We can analyze this in a manner very similar to linear regression on bivariate data. That is, we can use least squares to fit the model

y=β0​+β1​x1​+β2​x2​+⋯+βm​xm​.

Here each xj​ is a predictor variable and y is the response variable. For example, we might be interested in how a fish population varies with measured levels of several pollutants, or we might want to predict the adult height of a son based on the height of the mother and the height of the father.

We don’t have time in 18.05 to study multiple linear regression, but we wanted you to see the name.

多元线性回归 multiple linear regression 同时使用 m 个预测变量. β0​ 是截距, βj​ 描述模型中 xj​ 与响应的关系. Slide 20 给出了无截距写法 yi​=a1​xi,1​+⋯+am​xi,m​+E, 最小化 ∑i​(yi​−y^​i​)2 的思想相同.

多个预测变量共存时, 单个系数不能自动解释为因果效应. 变量之间还可能相关, 本课不展开这些估计与解释问题.

作为统计模型的最小二乘
Least Squares as a Statistical Model

Page 7

6 Least squares as a statistical model

The linear regression model for fitting a line says that the value yi​ in the pair (xi​,yi​) is drawn from a random variable

Yi​=axi​+b+εi​

where the ‘error’ terms εi​ are independent random variables with mean 0 and standard deviation σ. The standard assumption is that the εi​ are i.i.d. with distribution N(0,σ2).

So, the mean of Yi​ is given by:

E[Yi​]=axi​+b+E[εi​]=axi​+b.

From this perspective, the least squares method chooses the values of a and b which minimize the sample variance about the line.

In fact, under the assumption that εi​∼N(0,σ2), the least square estimate (a^,b^) coincides with the maximum likelihood estimate for the parameters (a,b); that is, among all possible coefficients, (a^,b^) are the ones that make the observed data most probable.

这里把误差的概率假设补齐: 独立、均值 0、共同方差 σ2, 通常还设为正态分布. 因此在给定 xi​,a,b 时, Yi​∼N(axi​+b,σ2).

正态密度中与 a,b 有关的部分只有 exp(−εi2​/(2σ2)). 最大化似然等价于最小化 ∑i​εi2​, 所以正态独立同方差模型下, 最大似然估计 maximum likelihood estimate 与最小二乘估计一致.

课堂题: 套公式并连接 MLE
Board Question: Using the Formulas plus Some Theory

Slide 15

Board Question: using the formulas plus some theory

Bivariate data: (1,3),(2,1),(4,4)

  1. Calculate the sample means for x and y.
  2. Use the formulas to find a best-fit line in the xy-plane.
    a^=sxx​sxy​​,b^=yˉ​−a^xˉ
    sxy​=n−11​∑(xi​−xˉ)(yi​−yˉ​),sxx​=n−11​∑(xi​−xˉ)2.
  3. Show the point (xˉ,yˉ​) is always on the fitted line.
  4. (For fun later!) Under the assumption Ei​∼N(0,σ2) show that the least squares method is equivalent to finding the MLE for the parameters (a,b).
    Hint: f(yi​∣xi​,a,b)∼N(axi​+b,σ2).

(a, b) 数值: 与上一道课堂题相同, xˉ=7/3,yˉ​=8/3, 拟合线为 y^​=x/2+3/2.

(c) 样本中心: 把 x=xˉ 代入拟合线:

y^​=a^xˉ+b^=a^xˉ+(yˉ​−a^xˉ)=yˉ​.

所以 (xˉ,yˉ​) 总在拟合线上.

(d) 似然推导: 假设各误差独立且 Ei​∼N(0,σ2), 则 Yi​∣xi​,a,b∼N(axi​+b,σ2). 联合似然为

L(a,b)=i=1∏n​2πσ2​1​exp[−2σ2(yi​−axi​−b)2​].

去掉与 a,b 无关的常数后, 对数似然是

ℓ(a,b)=−2σ21​i=1∑n​(yi​−axi​−b)2+C.

当 σ>0 固定时, 最大化 ℓ 就等价于最小化总平方误差. 若 σ 也未知, 对 (a,b) 的最大似然估计仍然相同.

幻灯片小错: (d) 的 Hint 写成 f(yi​∣xi​,a,b)∼N(axi​+b,σ2), 把密度函数 f 当作随机变量来写分布. 可改为 Yi​∣xi​,a,b∼N(axi​+b,σ2), 或直接写 f(yi​∣xi​,a,b)=2πσ2​1​exp[−(yi​−axi​−b)2/(2σ2)].

向均值回归
Regression to the Mean

Pages 7–8

7 Regression to the mean

The reason for the term ‘regression’ is that the predicted response variable y will tend to be ‘closer’ to (i.e., regress to) its mean than the predictor variable x is to its mean. Here closer is in quotes because we have to control for the scale (i.e. standard deviation) of each variable. The way we control for scale is to first standardize each variable.

ui​=sxx​​xi​−xˉ​,vi​=syy​​yi​−yˉ​​.

Standardization changes the mean to 0 and variance to 1:

uˉ=vˉ=0,suu​=svv​=1.

The algebraic properties of covariance show

suv​=sxx​syy​​sxy​​=ρ,

the correlation coefficient. Thus the least squares fit to v=au+b has

a^=suu​suv​​=ρandb^=vˉ−a^uˉ=0.

So the least squares line is v=ρu. Since ρ is the correlation coefficient, it is between -1 and 1. Let’s assume it is positive and less than 1 (i.e., x and y are positively but not perfectly correlated). Then the formula v=ρu means that if u is positive then the predicted value of v is less than u. That is, v is closer to 0 than u. Equivalently,

syy​​y−yˉ​​<sxx​​x−xˉ​

i.e., y regresses to yˉ​. Notice how the standardization takes care of controlling the scale.

Consider the extreme case of 0 correlation between x and y. Then, no matter what the x value, the predicted value of y is always yˉ​. That is, y has regressed all the way to its mean.

Note also that the regression line always goes through the point (xˉ,yˉ​).

标准化后, 回归线变成 v^=ρu. 当 0<ρ<1 时, 预测标准分 v^ 的绝对值小于输入标准分 u 的绝对值, 所以预测值比输入更靠近各自均值. 这里比较的是标准差单位, 不能直接比较身高、分数等不同单位的原数值.

这是一种平均趋势, 不是对每个人的必然预言. 也不表示整组数据第二次的均值必然向某个固定值移动.

Page 8

Example 10. Regression to the mean is important in longitudinal studies. Rice (Mathematical Statistics and Data Analysis) gives the following example. Suppose children are given an IQ test at age 4 and another at age 5 we expect the results will be positively correlated. The above analysis says that, on average, those kids who do poorly on the first test will tend to show improvement (i.e. regress to the mean) on the second test. Thus, a useless intervention might be misinterpreted as useful since it seems to improve scores.

Example 11. Another example with practical consequences is reward and punishment. Imagine a school where high performance on an exam is rewarded and low performance is punished. Regression to the mean tells us that (on average) the high performing students will do slightly worse on the next exam and the low performing students will do slightly better. An unsophisticated view of the data will make it seem that punishment improved performance and reward actually hurt performance. There are real consequences if those in authority act on this idea.

纵向研究 longitudinal study 反复观察同一批对象. 若只挑第一次得分最低的人接受干预, 他们第二次平均得分即使上升, 也不能把全部变化归因于干预; 第一次极高分组随后平均回落也是同理.

要识别干预效果, 需要合适的对照与分配机制. 「奖励使成绩变差」和「惩罚使成绩变好」都可能是向均值回归造成的错觉.

Appendix: Proof of the Formula for Least Square Fit of a Line

Page 9

8 Appendix

We collect in this appendix a few things you might find interesting. You will not be asked to know these things for exams.

8.1 Proof of the formula for least square fit of a line

The most straightforward proof is to use calculus. The sum of the squared errors is

S(b,a)=i=1∑n​(yi​−axi​−b)2.

Taking partial derivatives (and remembering that xi​ and yi​ are the data, hence constant)

∂b∂S​=i=1∑n​−2(yi​−axi​−b)=0,
∂a∂S​=i=1∑n​−2xi​(yi​−axi​−b)=0.

Summing this up we get two linear equations in the unknowns b and a:

(∑xi​)a+nb=∑yi​,
(∑xi2​)a+(∑xi​)b=∑xi​yi​.

Solving for a and b gives the formulas in Equation (1).

A sneakier approach which avoids calculus is to standardize the data, find the best fit line, and then unstandardize. We omit the details.

For a slew of applications across disciplines see:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linear_regression#Applications_of_linear_regression

第一式除以 −2 得 ∑i​(yi​−axi​−b)=0, 整理就是截距方程. 第二式给出斜率与截距共同满足的方程; 联立后即 a^=sxy​/sxx​ 和 b^=yˉ​−a^xˉ.

这两个方程也叫 正规方程 normal equations. S 是关于 (a,b) 的凸二次函数, 在 sxx​>0 时驻点给出唯一最小值.

用 R² 衡量拟合
Measuring the Fit

Pages 9–10

8.2 Measuring the fit

Once one computes the regression coefficients, it is important to check how well the regression model fits the data (i.e., how closely the best fit line tracks the data). A common but crude ‘goodness of fit’ measure is the coefficient of determination, denoted R2. We’ll need some notation to define it. The total sum of squares is given by:

TSS=∑(yi​−yˉ​)2.

The residual sum of squares is given by the sum of the squares of the residuals. When fitting a line, this is:

RSS=∑(yi​−a^xi​−b^)2.

The RSS is the “unexplained” portion of the total sum of squares, i.e. unexplained by the regression equation. The difference TSS−RSS is the “explained” portion of the total sum of squares. The coefficient of determination R2 is the ratio of the “explained” portion to the total sum of squares:

R2=TSSTSS−RSS​.

In other words, R2 measures the proportion of the variability of the data that is accounted for by the regression model. A value close to 1 indicates a good fit, while a value close to 0 indicates a poor fit. In the case of simple linear regression, R2 is simply the square of the correlation coefficient between the observed values yi​ and the predicted values axi​+b.

Example 12. In the overfitting example (9), the values of R2 are:

degreeR2
10.3968
20.9455
91.0000

Notice the goodness of fit measure increases as n increases. The fit is better, but the model also becomes more complex, since it takes more coefficients to describe higher order polynomials.

总平方和 total sum of squares TSS 是相对于均值 yˉ​ 的总变异; 残差平方和 residual sum of squares RSS 是模型仍未解释的部分. 决定系数 coefficient of determination R2=1−RSS/TSS 表示由模型解释的样本变异比例.

九次模型穿过全部十个训练点, 所以 RSS = 0 且 R2=1. 这正好说明高 R2 只代表当前数据拟合得好, 不排除过拟合, 也不保证对新数据预测得好.

在带截距的简单线性回归中, 观测 yi​ 与拟合值 y^​i​=a^xi​+b^ 的相关系数平方等于 R2; 也等于 x 与 y 的样本相关系数平方.

幻灯片错误: Example 12 末段写「the goodness of fit measure increases as n increases」. 本例的样本量始终为 10, 表中改变的是多项式次数 d=1,2,9. 应为「increases as the degree increases」.
